user.title: Parental control
user.description: Choose the parent code required to unlock from a non-admin account (wall tablet).

error.invalid_code: The code must be 4 to 8 digits.
The code must be 4 to 8 digits.

code_required.message: A parent code is required for this action.

not_configured.message: Parental control has no configuration yet.

invalid_target.message: This target is not valid for this action.

timer_active.message: A timer is already running for this child.

not_in_quota.message: Timers can only be started during a quota period.

code_locked.message: Too many wrong parent codes. Try again in {seconds} s.

devoirs_termines.name: Homework done
devoirs_termines.description: Marks today's homework as done for a child, which unlocks the after-homework period. Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

ajouter_bonus.name: Add bonus
ajouter_bonus.description: Adds bonus minutes for today to a child or to a resource (exactly one of the two). Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

exception.name: Manual exception
exception.description: Forces a resource, a child or a service open or closed. Returns the exception id. Opening requires the parent code from a non-admin account; closing never does.

open.name: Open
open.description: On to open, off to close.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Duration (1 to 240 minutes). Empty: until the next scheduled change.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account to open.

annuler_exception.name: Cancel exception
annuler_exception.description: Removes a manual exception. Cancelling a closure re-opens and requires the parent code from a non-admin account.

exception_id.name: Exception id
exception_id.description: Id returned by the exception action.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account when cancelling a closure.

demarrer_minuteur.name: Start timer
demarrer_minuteur.description: Starts a screen-time timer for a child during a quota period, capped to the remaining quota. Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

arreter_minuteur.name: Stop timer
arreter_minuteur.description: Stops the running timer of a child. No code required.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Global pause: closes every resource immediately. Ending the pause requires the parent code from a non-admin account.

active.name: Active
active.description: On to pause, off to resume.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account to resume.

importer_configuration.name: Import configuration
importer_configuration.description: Replaces the whole configuration (kids, resources, schedules). Administrators only.
